data.name: Staybridge Suites Saltillo by IHG
data.address: Parque Centro, Blvd. Corporativo, Manzana 1E Lote 3A-No. 177, 25279 Saltillo, Coah., Mexico
data.description:
In a commercial area off Highway 40, this informal all-suite hotel is 3 minutes' walk from Galerías Saltillo Mall and 13 km from Saltillo Airport.
Understated studios provide complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and kitchens, as well as work desks. Suites add living rooms.
Parking is free, as is a breakfast buffet served in an airy dining room. There are regular evening socials. Other amenities consist of a 24-hour gym, a heated outdoor pool, plus a terrace with BBQ facilities, and a guest laundry. An area shuttle is available.
